_README: THIS IS ROB'S FILE. Edit it, commit, done. Nothing else needs to change.
Add an object to the array under the module number it teaches. Every field except
`title` and `url` is optional, and a missing field just renders nothing.
"title":   "How a switch builds its MAC address table",   <- required
"start":   410,          <- optional, seconds; jumps straight to the relevant part
"mine":    false         <- true for videos Rob recorded; they sort first and get a badge
A module with an empty array renders a 'no videos yet' placeholder. That is fine,
it is not broken. Playlists work too; paste the playlist URL as `url`.
Suggested sources are listed on the /packet/resources/ page.
